_comment: Per-option descriptions keyed by source-model class (exact string as the live extractor reports it, including any ::method). Reused across every field that uses the source model. Self-explanatory enums (units, GET/POST, light/dark, sandbox/prod) are intentionally omitted — their label is the meaning.

Magento\\Payment\\Model\\Config\\Source\.0: Offer this method in every country your store already allows.
Magento\\Payment\\Model\\Config\\Source\.1: Limit this method to the specific countries you pick below.

Magento\\Shipping\\Model\\Config\\Source.0: Offer this method in every country your store already allows.
Magento\\Shipping\\Model\\Config\\Source.1: Limit this method to the specific countries you pick below.

Magento\\Paypal\\Model\\Config::getApiAu.0: Authenticate to PayPal with an API signature (username, password, signature).
Magento\\Paypal\\Model\\Config::getApiAu.1: Authenticate to PayPal with an uploaded API certificate instead of a signature.

Magento\\Paypal\\Model\\System\\Config\\.1: Show the PayPal shortcut button (PayPal's recommended choice).

Magento\\Paypal\\Model\\Config::getExpre.Sole: Let shoppers pay without a PayPal account (guest checkout allowed).
Magento\\Paypal\\Model\\Config::getExpre.Mark: Require shoppers to sign in to a PayPal account to pay.

Magento\\Paypal\\Model\\Config::getExpre.auto: Create a billing agreement automatically where one is possible.
Magento\\Paypal\\Model\\Config::getExpre.ask: Ask the customer whether to set up a billing agreement.
Magento\\Paypal\\Model\\Config::getExpre.never: Never offer a billing agreement at checkout.

Magento\\Config\\Model\\Config\\Source\\.general: Send as the General Contact store identity.
Magento\\Config\\Model\\Config\\Source\\.sales: Send as the Sales Representative store identity.
Magento\\Config\\Model\\Config\\Source\\.support: Send as the Customer Support store identity.
Magento\\Config\\Model\\Config\\Source\\.custom1: Send as the Custom Email 1 store identity.
Magento\\Config\\Model\\Config\\Source\\.custom2: Send as the Custom Email 2 store identity.

Magento\\Config\\Model\\Config\\Source\\.bcc: Send one email and blind-copy the extra recipients.
Magento\\Config\\Model\\Config\\Source\\.copy: Send each recipient a separate copy of the email.

Magento\\Paypal\\Model\\System\\Config\\.CREDIT: Hide the PayPal Credit funding option at checkout.
Magento\\Paypal\\Model\\System\\Config\\.VENMO: Hide the Venmo funding option at checkout.
Magento\\Paypal\\Model\\System\\Config\\.CARD: Hide the guest credit-card (unbranded card) option at checkout.
Magento\\Paypal\\Model\\System\\Config\\.ELV: Hide the German ELV direct-debit funding option at checkout.

Magento\\ReCaptchaAdminUi\\Model\\Option.recaptcha: Visible "I'm not a robot" checkbox (reCAPTCHA v2).
Magento\\ReCaptchaAdminUi\\Model\\Option.invisible: Invisible badge that challenges only suspicious visitors (reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible).
Magento\\ReCaptchaAdminUi\\Model\\Option.recaptcha_v3: Scores every request silently with no challenge (reCAPTCHA v3).

Magento\\Sales\\Model\\Config\\Source\\O.pending: Place new orders in the Pending status.
Magento\\Sales\\Model\\Config\\Source\\O.processing: Place new orders straight into Processing.
Magento\\Sales\\Model\\Config\\Source\\O.fraud: Flag new orders as Suspected Fraud for manual review.

Magento\\Config\\Model\\Config\\Source\\.opt: Show the field but let shoppers leave it blank.
Magento\\Config\\Model\\Config\\Source\\.req: Show the field and require it to be filled in.

Magento\\Tax\\Model\\System\\Config\\Sou.1: Show prices with tax left out.
Magento\\Tax\\Model\\System\\Config\\Sou.2: Show prices with tax already included.
Magento\\Tax\\Model\\System\\Config\\Sou.3: Show both the tax-excluded and tax-included price.

Magento\\Tax\\Model\\System\\Config\\Sou.0: Prices you enter are treated as not including tax.
Magento\\Tax\\Model\\System\\Config\\Sou.1: Prices you enter are treated as already including tax.

Magento\\Tax\\Model\\Config\\Source\\Bas.shipping: Calculate tax from the customer's shipping address.
Magento\\Tax\\Model\\Config\\Source\\Bas.billing: Calculate tax from the customer's billing address.
Magento\\Tax\\Model\\Config\\Source\\Bas.origin: Calculate tax from the store's shipping origin.

Magento\\Tax\\Model\\System\\Config\\Sou.0: Apply tax to the price before any discount.
Magento\\Tax\\Model\\System\\Config\\Sou.1: Apply tax to the price after the discount.

Magento\\Tax\\Model\\Config\\Source\\App.0: Tax the custom price when one is set, otherwise the original.
Magento\\Tax\\Model\\Config\\Source\\App.1: Always tax the original price, ignoring custom prices.

Magento\\Tax\\Model\\System\\Config\\Sou.UNIT_BASE_CALCULATION: Round tax on each unit, then multiply by quantity.
Magento\\Tax\\Model\\System\\Config\\Sou.ROW_BASE_CALCULATION: Round tax once per line (row total).
Magento\\Tax\\Model\\System\\Config\\Sou.TOTAL_BASE_CALCULATION: Round tax once on the order total.

Magento\\Catalog\\Model\\Config\\Source\.0: One price per product across the whole catalog.
Magento\\Catalog\\Model\\Config\\Source\.1: Allow a different price per website.

Magento\\Weee\\Model\\Config\\Source\\Di.0: Show the price including the fixed product tax, with no separate line.
Magento\\Weee\\Model\\Config\\Source\\Di.1: Show the price including the fee, plus a line describing it.
Magento\\Weee\\Model\\Config\\Source\\Di.2: Show the price without the fee, plus the fee description and final price.
Magento\\Weee\\Model\\Config\\Source\\Di.3: Show the price with the fixed product tax left out.

Magento\\Sitemap\\Model\\Config\\Source\.always: Hint to crawlers that the page changes every visit.
Magento\\Sitemap\\Model\\Config\\Source\.hourly: Hint that the page changes about hourly.
Magento\\Sitemap\\Model\\Config\\Source\.daily: Hint that the page changes about daily.
Magento\\Sitemap\\Model\\Config\\Source\.weekly: Hint that the page changes about weekly.
Magento\\Sitemap\\Model\\Config\\Source\.monthly: Hint that the page changes about monthly.
Magento\\Sitemap\\Model\\Config\\Source\.yearly: Hint that the page changes about yearly.
Magento\\Sitemap\\Model\\Config\\Source\.never: Hint that the page is archived and won't change.

Magento\\Sitemap\\Model\\Config\\Source\.standard: Build the whole sitemap in memory in one pass.
Magento\\Sitemap\\Model\\Config\\Source\.batch: Build the sitemap in smaller batches to use less memory on large catalogs.

Magento\\Security\\Model\\Config\\Source.1: Rate-limit password resets by both IP address and email.
Magento\\Security\\Model\\Config\\Source.2: Rate-limit password resets by IP address.
Magento\\Security\\Model\\Config\\Source.3: Rate-limit password resets by email address.

Magento\\Captcha\\Model\\Config\\Mode.after_fail: Show the CAPTCHA only after a number of failed attempts.

Magento\\Shipping\\Model\\Source\\Handli.P: Add handling as a percentage of the rate.

Magento\\Shipping\\Model\\Source\\Handli.O: Apply the handling fee once per order.
Magento\\Shipping\\Model\\Source\\Handli.P: Apply the handling fee to each package.

Magento\\Shipping\\Model\\Config\\Source.0: Split the cart into equal weights and send one rate request.
Magento\\Shipping\\Model\\Config\\Source.1: Use the real package weight and send a request per package.

Magento\\OfflineShipping\\Model\\Config\.O: Charge the flat rate once per order.
Magento\\OfflineShipping\\Model\\Config\.I: Charge the flat rate for each item.

Magento\\OfflineShipping\\Model\\Config\.package_weight: Look up the rate by weight and destination.
Magento\\OfflineShipping\\Model\\Config\.package_value_with_discount: Look up the rate by order value and destination.
Magento\\OfflineShipping\\Model\\Config\.package_qty: Look up the rate by number of items and destination.

Magento\\PageCache\\Model\\System\\Confi.1: Use Magento's built-in PHP full-page cache.
Magento\\PageCache\\Model\\System\\Confi.2: Use Varnish as the full-page cache (recommended for production).

Magento\\Checkout\\Model\\Config\\Source.0: Show the count of line items in the mini-cart.
Magento\\Checkout\\Model\\Config\\Source.1: Show the total quantity of units in the mini-cart.

Magento\\Wishlist\\Model\\Config\\Source.0: Show the count of items in the wish-list summary.
Magento\\Wishlist\\Model\\Config\\Source.1: Show the total quantity of units in the wish-list summary.

Magento\\Checkout\\Model\\Config\\Source.guest: When carts merge at login, keep the guest cart's quantities.
Magento\\Checkout\\Model\\Config\\Source.customer: When carts merge at login, keep the saved customer cart's quantities.
Magento\\Checkout\\Model\\Config\\Source.merge: When carts merge at login, add the quantities together.

Magento\\Checkout\\Model\\Adminhtml\\Bil.0: Collect the billing address on the payment step.
Magento\\Checkout\\Model\\Adminhtml\\Bil.1: Collect the billing address on its own page.

Magento\\Config\\Model\\Config\\Source\\.0: Do not redirect between base URLs.

Magento\\Developer\\Model\\Config\\Sourc.client_side_compilation: Compile LESS in the browser — convenient for development.
Magento\\Developer\\Model\\Config\\Sourc.server_side_compilation: Compile LESS on the server — correct for production.

Magento\\Translation\\Model\\Js\\Config\.dictionary: Translate JavaScript strings on the storefront from a dictionary file.
Magento\\Translation\\Model\\Js\\Config\.embedded: Embed translations at render time on the server side.

Magento\\Msrp\\Model\\Product\\Attribute.1: Reveal the price when the shopper acts (hover/click gesture).
Magento\\Msrp\\Model\\Product\\Attribute.2: Reveal the price only once the product is in the cart.
Magento\\Msrp\\Model\\Product\\Attribute.3: Reveal the price just before order confirmation.

Magento\\SendFriend\\Model\\Source\\Chec.1: Count send-to-friend limits by IP address.
Magento\\SendFriend\\Model\\Source\\Chec.0: Count send-to-friend limits by cookie (can be cleared — less safe).

Magento\\TwoFactorAuth\\Model\\Config\\S.u2fkey: Hardware security key (U2F — YubiKey and similar).

Magento\\InventoryIndexer\\Model\\Reinde.sync: Update stock indexes immediately as changes happen.
Magento\\InventoryIndexer\\Model\\Reinde.async: Update stock indexes in the background via the queue.

Magento\\GoogleAdwords\\Model\\Config\\S.1: Report the actual order value for conversions.
Magento\\GoogleAdwords\\Model\\Config\\S.0: Report a fixed constant value for conversions.

Magento\\NewRelicReporting\\Model\\Confi.v2_rest: Send data through the legacy v2 REST API.
Magento\\NewRelicReporting\\Model\\Confi.nerdgraph: Send data through the NerdGraph (GraphQL) API (recommended).

Magento\\User\\Model\\System\\Config\\So.0: Admins are prompted to change their password but not forced.
Magento\\User\\Model\\System\\Config\\So.1: Admins are forced to change their password on the schedule.

Magento\\Directory\\Model\\Currency\\Imp.fixerio_apilayer: Import rates from Fixer via APILayer.
Magento\\Directory\\Model\\Currency\\Imp.currencyconverterapi: Import rates from Currency Converter API.

Magento\\Config\\Model\\Config\\Source\\.2: Use the custom value specified below.

Magento\\CatalogUrlRewrite\\Model\\Syste.website: Generate product URL rewrites per website.
Magento\\CatalogUrlRewrite\\Model\\Syste.store_view: Generate product URL rewrites per store view.

Magento\\Cms\\Model\\Config\\Source\\Wys.enabled: Editor is on by default and can be toggled off.
Magento\\Cms\\Model\\Config\\Source\\Wys.hidden: Editor is off by default but can be toggled on.

Magento\\LoginAsCustomerAdminUi\\Model\\.0: Pick the store view automatically when logging in as a customer.
Magento\\LoginAsCustomerAdminUi\\Model\\.1: Let the admin choose the store view manually.

Magento\\Catalog\\Model\\Config\\Source\.grid: Show products as a grid only.
Magento\\Catalog\\Model\\Config\\Source\.list: Show products as a list only.
Magento\\Catalog\\Model\\Config\\Source\.grid-list: Grid by default, with a toggle to list.
Magento\\Catalog\\Model\\Config\\Source\.list-grid: List by default, with a toggle to grid.

Magento\\Catalog\\Model\\Config\\Source\.position: Default sort by the position set in the category.
Magento\\Catalog\\Model\\Config\\Source\.name: Default sort by product name.

Magento\\Catalog\\Model\\Config\\Source\.auto: Build price ranges with equal spans automatically.
Magento\\Catalog\\Model\\Config\\Source\.improved: Build price ranges with roughly equal product counts.
Magento\\Catalog\\Model\\Config\\Source\.manual: Use the fixed price step you set.

Magento\\Catalog\\Model\\Config\\Source\.image_optimization_parameters: Serve image variants via query parameters (CDN-friendly).
Magento\\Catalog\\Model\\Config\\Source\.hash: Serve each variant as a uniquely hashed file (legacy).

Magento\\MediaStorage\\Model\\Config\\So.0: Store media files on the file system.
Magento\\MediaStorage\\Model\\Config\\So.1: Store media files in the database (deprecated).

Magento\\Downloadable\\Model\\System\\Co.inline: Let the browser open downloadable files in place.

Magento\\Downloadable\\Model\\System\\Co.1: Grant access to downloads once the order is Pending.
Magento\\Downloadable\\Model\\System\\Co.9: Grant access to downloads only after the order is Invoiced.

Magento\\Config\\Model\\Config\\Source\\.store: Aggregate report data per store view.

Magento\\Catalog\\Model\\Config\\Source\.itself: Use each product's own thumbnail in the cart.

Magento\\SalesRule\\Model\\System\\Confi.alphanum: Generate codes with letters and digits.

Magento\\CardinalCommerce\\Model\\Adminh.sandbox: Use the Cardinal sandbox for testing.

Magento\\Quote\\Model\\Backpressure\\Con.60: Measure the request limit per minute.
Magento\\Quote\\Model\\Backpressure\\Con.3600: Measure the request limit per hour.
Magento\\Quote\\Model\\Backpressure\\Con.86400: Measure the request limit per day.
